entries.proposition: DRG evaluation in mice rests on a careful analysis of high-dose sections reported as normal histopathology.
entries.snippet: a careful analysis of DRG tissue sections from mice in the high-dose group revealed healthy cells and normal histopathology
entries.anchor: Results, Assessment of INS1201 toxicity, mouse paragraph

entries.proposition: The DRG histology figure is one image from one animal at the highest dose.
entries.snippet: (image is from animal administered highest dose, 8.0E+11 vg)

entries.proposition: DRG held many vector genomes but no transgene mRNA, because the promoter is muscle-derived.
entries.snippet: although high numbers of vector genomes were identified in the DRG, there was an absence of INS1201 mRNA expression
entries.anchor: Results, Biodistribution of INS1201 in WT mice and NHPs

entries.proposition: The NOAELs equal the highest doses tested, set by feasible dose, not by an observed toxic threshold.
entries.snippet: The NOAELs for these studies were 8.0E+11 vg/animal in mice and 3.05E+14 vg/animal in NHPs, both of which were the highest tested doses

entries.proposition: The mouse top dose was limited by maximum ICV volume and titer.
entries.snippet: was based on the limitation of maximum volume for ICV injections in mice and viral titer concentration
entries.anchor: Results, Assessment of INS1201 toxicity, mouse paragraph

entries.proposition: NHP GLP study: single lumbar IT dose, three animals per dose and three vehicle animals, 3-month necropsy.
entries.snippet: by lumbar IT injection (n = 3 per group); vehicle control NHPs (n = 3) were also included

entries.proposition: Anti-AAV9 antibody titre above 1:50 was an exclusion criterion for NHPs.
entries.snippet: Animals with AAV9 antibody titer levels above 1:50 dilution were excluded from the study.

entries.proposition: All NHPs treated with INS1201 developed anti-AAV9 antibodies by day 28.
entries.snippet: Anti-AAV9 antibodies were detected in all animals treated with INS1201 on days 28 and 92/93.
entries.anchor: Results, Assessment of INS1201 toxicity, NHP paragraph

entries.proposition: Transient transaminase and platelet changes occurred in individual NHPs without microscopic correlates.
entries.snippet: Non-adverse, transient, INS1201-related effects were noted in individual animals on clinical pathology parameters, including changes in platelet count, aspartate transaminase, and/or alanine transaminase
entries.anchor: Results, Assessment of INS1201 toxicity, NHP paragraph

entries.proposition: Minimal focal mononuclear infiltrates along the injection path were judged non-adverse in mice.
entries.snippet: non-adverse, focal, and minimal mononuclear cell infiltrates in the brain were noted in some individual animals treated with INS1201, without a dose-response relationship
entries.anchor: Results, Assessment of INS1201 toxicity, mouse paragraph

entries.proposition: Mouse-to-NHP dose equivalence was set by CSF volume, a 250-fold scale-up.
entries.snippet: scale up from mice with estimated CSF volume of 0.04 mL to juvenile NHP with estimated CSF volume of 10 mL
entries.anchor: Results, Biodistribution of INS1201 in WT mice and NHPs

entries.proposition: Efficacy plateaued across doses; the authors attribute it to the treatment age at which damage had already occurred.
entries.snippet: further increases in dose might not be expected to provide additional added benefit when dosed at this time point

entries.proposition: Toxicology studies were single-dose, in juvenile male animals.
entries.snippet: The toxicity of INS1201 was assessed in single-dose, GLP-compliant toxicology studies in juvenile (p28) male WT mice and NHPs

entries.proposition: Transgene RNA was found in muscle; non-muscle tissue negative except two of three midbrain samples.
entries.snippet: with the exception of two out of three midbrain samples from NHPs in the high-dose group
entries.anchor: Results, Biodistribution of INS1201 in WT mice and NHPs
